name: Old Bodija
vibe: Upscale, established residential haven with quiet tree-lined avenues and top tier dining.
security_level: High (Community gated checkpoints with night watch)
transit_access: Excellent. Easy Micra cabs to Secretariat, UI, and Mokola.
insider_tips: Old Bodija has significantly more serene plots and mature trees than New Bodija, which tends to be more commercial.

name: New Bodija
vibe: Energetic, lifestyle-oriented mix of residential apartments, modern lounges, supermarkets, and cafes.
flood_risk: Low to Moderate near drainage lines
security_level: Medium-High (Close knit streets with iron barrier gates closed at 10 PM)
transit_access: Very high, central location connecting to Secretariat and Sango.
insider_tips: Pay attention to proximity to commercial lounges if you prefer silence on weekends.

name: Agodi GRA
vibe: Premier diplomatic and executive government residential area; quiet, leafy, and highly secure.
transit_access: Strictly private or ride-hailing (Uber/Bolt) inside the estate.
insider_tips: Pedestrian commercial transit is restricted inside the GRA; owning a car or using ride hailing is typical.

name: Iyaganku GRA
vibe: Aristocratic heritage neighborhood, lush hills, tranquil, and home to senior magistrates and corporate titans.
security_level: Maximum (Iyaganku Police Command nearby, active gates)
transit_access: Quick access to Ring Road, Dugbe CBD, and Lekan Salami Stadium.
landmarks: Oyo State High Court Judges Quarters
insider_tips: Excellent for professionals working in Dugbe or Ring Road who value tranquility.

name: Oluyole Estate
vibe: Vibrant, family-friendly modern hub with great dining, gyms, shopping centers, and tech companies.
flood_risk: Low on high ground; check lower stream axis near industrial layout
road_condition: Tarred major roads, interlocked estate closes
security_level: High (Zonal resident associations with armed security guards)
transit_access: Directly accessible via Ring Road with abundant transport.
insider_tips: Oluyole Estate Extension offers newer architectural finishes compared to the core Oluyole Estate.

name: Jericho GRA
vibe: Historic high-prestige residential enclave, peaceful, green, close to research institutes and premier schools.
transit_access: 5 minutes to Eleyele, Dugbe, and Onireke.
insider_tips: Jericho is one of the coolest micro-climates in Ibadan due to nearby forest reserves.

name: Samonda / Sango / UI
vibe: Young, academic, tech-friendly innovation strip bustling with students, remote workers, and university staff.
flood_risk: Low on the ridges; moderate along stream channels
road_condition: Tarred on main roads, graded on inner streets
water_quality: Boreholes and local water cart vendors
transit_access: Unbeatable public transit connectivity (Micras, buses, tricycles).
insider_tips: Aerodrome Estate in Samonda is an exclusive gated enclave inside this vibrant corridor.

name: Akobo / Oju-Irin
vibe: Fast developing middle-class residential area with spacious modern compounds, new duplexes, and growing schools.
flood_risk: Low to Moderate (Always verify culvert quality during rainy season)
road_condition: Good on the dualized General Gas flyover axis; inner roads mixed
security_level: Moderate to High in private estates (e.g., Kolapo Ishola Estate)
transit_access: Great connectivity via General Gas flyover and Iwo Road link.
insider_tips: Properties located within Kolapo Ishola Estate command premium GRA-level rents and security.

name: Alalubosa GRA
vibe: Ultra-modern luxury gated community with contemporary mansions, strict access gates, and serene lake views.
road_condition: Fully interlocked roads and underground drainage
security_level: Maximum (CCTV monitored entrance, biometric pass for visitors)
transit_access: Quick access to Aleshinloye Market, Ring Road, and Eleyele.
insider_tips: One of the most modern GRA developments in Oyo State with uniform estate aesthetics.
